other_conditions: Organization must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 or the relevant Act of the State/Union Territory
Organization may be a public trust registered under the law temporarily
Organization may be a charitable company licensed under Section 25 of the Companies Act 1958
Organization must have been in existence for at least two years
Organization must have a properly constituted governing body with powers, duties, and responsibilities documented in writing
Organization must have sufficient resources, facilities, and experience to undertake the proposed project
Organization must not be run for profit of any individual or a body of individuals
Organization must not discriminate against any individual or group on the basis of sex, religion, caste, or creed
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to voluntary organizations for programs that enable education, skill development, early intervention, infrastructure upgrades, and capacity building for persons with disabilities.
